# dsh-tab-alert
> DSH Web tab alert: when an agent turn finishes while the browser tab is in the background, the tab

title flashes "New Message!"; returning to the tab stops it instantly.
>
> 中文
## Behavior

- Turn **running**: nothing happens.
- Turn **finished** while the tab is **hidden**: the title alte

rnates between `New Message!` and the original title every second.
- User returns to the tab (visibi

litychange): blinking stops immediately, the title is restored.
- Turn finishes while the tab is vis
ible: no blinking (the user already saw it).

`mainViewSessionId` resolves the main-view session via `retainedBy.mainView > 0`; `sessions.list` ch
anges trigger an immediate callback plus a 2s polling fallback. If the service is unavailable or the
record lacks the `running` field, it falls back to the DOM check `[data-chat-flow-kind="turn-proces
s"]` (the dsh-auto-collapse contract).
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]

## Compatibility
DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (web client). MIT license.
